commandKind: Portable reproduction recipe, not a machine-local invocation

body.gate: Weighted Brier strictly lower AND weighted AUC at least age/sex-only; prespecified; no CI significance gate and no holdout retuning

pairedBootstrap.method: 200 seeded Rao-Wu rescaled PSU-within-stratum resamples; paired fixed-model metrics; percentile 95% intervals
pairedBootstrap.scope: Holdout sampling uncertainty conditional on development fits and released imputations, not training uncertainty or an individual/lifetime confidence interval

body.coefficientUncertaintyMethod: Per-imputation lifelines PSU-cluster robust sandwich SE; Rubin within/between variances; t df capped at development PSU-minus-stratum df. Approximate with tied times; not full survey Taylor variance. Pooled coefficients are descriptive only: app predictions pool five risks, not coefficients.
body.syntheticOracleMethod: Four parent-specified invented inputs, not cohort records. Canonical shared design bridge; actual fitted lifelines predict_survival_function(times=[10]); average five risks for DXA variants. No exported equation or TS inference used as oracle.

protocol.split: Development NHANES 1999-2000/2001-2002/2003-2004; temporal holdout 2005-2006; no holdout tuning
protocol.folds: int.from_bytes(SHA256('bt-mortality-v1|<year>|<SEQN>')[0:8], 'big') % 3, assigned before eligibility/imputation; identical across MI
protocol.penalty: L2 values 0.001,0.01,0.1; choose minimum pooled out-of-fold MEC-weighted ten-year Brier on first imputation only; refit all five when body fat is required
protocol.weights: Development: 2/3*WTMEC4YR for 1999-2002, 1/3*WTMEC2YR for 2003-2004; holdout WTMEC2YR. Normalize mean one separately in each fit, only for penalty scaling; evaluate using original weights
protocol.surveyDesign: Retain full demographic strata/PSU maps before domain restriction; PSU nested in original disjoint SDMVSTRA. Cluster-robust fitted SE; 200 paired Rao-Wu within-stratum PSU bootstrap replicates on holdout, including empty domain PSUs
protocol.endpoint: All-cause death MORTSTAT==1 and PERMTH_EXM<=120; fit min(PERMTH_EXM,120)/12; keep early censored for Cox; exclude alive <120 only from binary evaluation; death after120 is a ten-year survivor
protocol.zeroTime: Zero released follow-up retained; only Cox time changes zero to0.5month, an analyst convention not CDC guidance; sensitivity at0.1 and1month if any development zero-time deaths
protocol.cox: lifelines0.30.0 weighted partial likelihood, Efron ties, Breslow cumulative baseline hazard; ridge penalizes standardized features internally. Export params_ on original design scale plus actual _norm_mean centering and baseline cumulative hazard at10years; equation checked against native fitted predictions
protocol.solver: Uniform deterministic initial Newton step0.25, precision1e-8, max500; all convergence warnings fatal. Default step0.95 failed in clinical development folds; the same fold at0.25 converged in9iterations without changing data or model
protocol.imputation: Five independent DXA Cox fits on identical participant splits; no averaged body-fat values and no stacked independent duplicates; risk predictions averaged, coefficient uncertainty uses within/between-imputation Rubin rules
protocol.activity: PAD320 moderate/PAD200 vigorous:2No or3Unable->zero;1Yes requires all matching records valid. Missing/refused/unknown stay missing. Sum every legitimate detail row; actual(M30+V30)*7/30, vigorous once; inability/inconsistency flags retained in aggregate metadata, not fitted extra predictors
protocol.creatinine: 1999 standardizedmg/dL=1.013*LBXSCR+0.147;2001 released LBDSCR unchanged;2003 LBXSCR unchanged;2005=-0.016+0.978*LBXSCR;then*88.4umol/L. Original native columns retained only in local memory
protocol.crp: Native LBXCRPmg/dL*10 to bridge canonicalmg/L; bridge PhenoAge converts internally.0.01 positive native values retained: documented floor in2003/2005, qualification uncertain in1999/2001
protocol.transforms: All medical PhenoAge/design calculations delegated via captured local Bun stdin/stdout to features.ts; no formula transcription in Python
protocol.rawPredictorRanges: Development-only min/max across five imputations when applicable; age omitted because ageFrom/ageTo defines domain; no heldout-based clipping or exclusions
protocol.inferencePriority: clinical_activity>clinical>body_activity>body>blood_activity>blood is input-coverage preference, not per-person accuracy ranking
protocol.transportZeroCorrection: Synthetic eight zero-byte IBM SAS double decodes as5.397605346934028e-79 in pandas2.2.3; normalize only exact decoder sentinel to0 at XPT import; count corrections per source
